question: Who among the following musicians was awarded India's highest civilian honour, the Bharat Ratna, in 1999?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pandit Ravi Shankar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pandit Ravi Shankar,** a sitar player, composer, and founder of the **National Orchestra of India, **received **India's highest civilian honor**, **the Bharat Ratna**, in **1999**.
 
• Throughout the latter half of the 20th century, he attained global recognition as the foremost exponent of North Indian classical music.
 
• Born in Benares (now Varanasi) in 1920, Shankar passed away in San Diego, California, in 2012.
 
• He garnered numerous prestigious musical accolades, including a **Polar Music Prize** and** five Grammy Awards**. Notably, he won Album of the Year for **"The Concert for Bangladesh"** in 1973.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Ustad Zakir Hussain**, born on March 9, 1951, is an Indian tabla player, composer, percussionist, music producer, and film actor. Recognized for his contributions, he received the Padma Shri in 1988, the Padma Bhushan in 2002, and the Padma Vibhushan in 2023 from the Government of India.
 
• **Ram Narayan,** an Indian musician, significantly popularized the sarangi as a solo concert instrument in Hindustani classical music, becoming the first internationally successful sarangi player.
 
• **Ustad Amjad Ali Khan,** renowned for his clear and fast ekhara taans on the sarod, is an Indian classical sarod player. He was honored with the Padma Vibhushan in 2001, the Padma Bhushan in 1991, and the Padma Shree in 1975, among India's highest civilian awards.
